# CC07: 流香渚 Liuxiang Zhu

Wave 3 · Changchun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=CC07` · Page: `/scenes/#CC07` · Row: `research/buildings/CC07-liuxiang-zhu/`

## What it was

流香渚 Liuxiang Zhu, a pavilion west of 海岳开襟 beyond the water, with 罨画溪 to its north; a path west from here reaches 明春门 of 圆明园 (S05 j83:11b-12a; E0166). Of 1747 with 海岳开襟 (E0164). A modern 3D model of the pavilion is R0100.

From the inventory row: **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S01).
